points.text: Touch controls: in the hub only map, food, and potion stay dimmed and non-interactive; all other buttons are fully enabled. In the dungeon every button is fully enabled.
Shots: new `--scheme pc|gamepad|touch` flag forces keyboard prompts, gamepad prompts, or the touch overlay for visual proofs.

entries.summary: Touch-pad buttons no longer appear disabled when usable; shot tool can force input scheme.

points.text: Process and tooling: pre-tool hook tightened; week-start no longer parks changelogs; asset-fit values refreshed.
Performance tooling expanded (dungeon/hub benches, layer isolation, playtest curve).
Telemetry and playtest campaign slot added; minor hub collision and shadow polish.

entries.summary: Grok Build Week 9 — tooling, process, asset-fit, and performance infrastructure.
